Bootstrap band #3 — issues whose dso-id label or dso_local_id property disagrees with the local tracker mapping.

- Applier executes only after stale-syncs-<pass>.attested.json is present, updates label and/or property to authoritative value ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Post-pass bridge-fsck stale-sync count drops to zero or to reviewer-acknowledged residual ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations
- [Risk] Flag entries crossing a known ID-space boundary for reviewer decision.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
